description: Docks Under Fire: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Raiders are boarding at {station} and the dock guard has only a few fighters. {client} pays you to cover the docks. Kill the boarding craft before they land.
A raid on {station}. The attackers want the cargo and do not care who is in the way. Break the boarding craft.
{station} has called for any ship in range. Boarders are coming in from the dark side.
success: The boarders are gone. {station} sends food to your ship and {client} pays.
Docks secure. {client} pays {captain} and the harbourmaster stops swearing.
The raid is broken. {client} pays and the dock guard buys a round, which is generous for them.
failure: The docks are lost. {client} withdraws the fee.
radio-boarders: Boarding craft inbound, behind. Shoot them before they dock.
Gunships with marines. Do not let them near the ring.
radio-support: Fighter cover for the boarders. Take them as they come.
Escorts. Six of them. Weapons free.
radio-leader: The raid leader is coming in, a frigate. It is not subtle.
Large contact. It is their command ship.
Frigate arriving. Do not let it fire on the ring.
